question: Vishnushastri Chiplunkar started a monthly Marathi magazine __________, in 1874 for the cause of social reform.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nibandhmala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Nibandhmala **was a monthly Marathi magazine written by **Vishnushastri Chiplunkar.**
 
• The magazine commented on various social and cultural issues.
 
• In 1874, he started the monthly Nibandhamala, for the cause of social reform for which he is principally remembered.
 
• Nearly all of the writing in the 84 issues of this periodical was published for 12 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pudhari **is a popular daily printed newspaper founded in 1937 by Pudhari Publications and continues to print in three centres and distributed in **Maharashtra, Goa, and North Karnataka.**
 
• Kesari is a Marathi newspaper founded in 1881 by Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak. It was used as a spokes piece for the Indian national freedom movement and continues to be published by the Kesari Maratha Trust and Tilak's descendants.
 
• Prabhakar is a newspaper started by Bhau Mahajan, it was started on the day of **Ankit in 1841.**
